name: Fortify
body:
Discipline psychometabolism
Level cryptic 1, gifted blade 1, psion/wilder 1, psychic warrior 1

MANIFESTING

Display Mental
Manifesting Time One standard action

EFFECT

Range Personal
Target You
Duration One minute/level
Power Points 1

DESCRIPTION

You imbue yourself with psionic energy that protects you from harm, granting yourself a +2 resistance bonus on saves.

Augment For every 2 additional power points you spend, you gain an additional +1 resistance bonus on saves.

Fortify, Lesser

DESCRIPTION

FAQ

This power was listed on the Cryptic power list in Psionics Expanded, but this information was omitted from the power description. Errata on the Dreamscarred Press forums confirmed that it is available to the Cryptic as per the published power list. This power’s entry has been updated to reflect this.
